business_problem: The video creation platform needed a powerful technological partner to access cutting-edge AI research, and it chose The platform’s orchestration of sub-agents handles the technical grunt work, allowing users to interact naturally, much like a director on a film set. “You don't have to babysit the AI,” says co-founder and CEO Sanket Shah.
solution_summary: InVideo rebuilt its platform using Google AI, enabling creators to produce high-quality videos up to 8x faster. The video creation platform needed a powerful technological partner to access cutting-edge AI research, and it chose InVideo to provide the core models, allowing its lean team to focus on orchestrating AI agents tailored for serious creatives, performance marketers, and filmmakers. This shift enabled InVideo to stay competitive and secure its position as one of the top AI video companies globally. Google Cloud is able to deliver cutting-edge research and frontier models that lift up hundreds of use cases. The performance and fidelity of their AI is what allows us to confidently build our platform and unlock exponential workflows for serious creatives.
